name: packstruct
description: The shared /packs spec: one manifest, entry, and lifecycle contract for crashtest and poststruct packs - plus a zero-dependency lint CLI that kills broken pack manifests at author time.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node --test test/status.test.mjs test/refusal-matrix.test.mjs test/run-capped.test.mjs tests/ship-from-download.test.cjs tests/release-verify.test.cjs tests/post-permalinks.test.cjs tests/distribution.test.cjs tests/check-action-pins.test.cjs && node --test tests/check-prestruct-pins.test.cjs
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-links.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-style.cjs && node scripts/check-jekyll-filters.cjs && node scripts/check-language.cjs
scripts.check: npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:pins && npm run lint:prestruct-pins && node scripts/check-legal.cjs && npm run matrix:check && npm run lint:packs && npm run conform:packs && npm run conform:claims
